column1: # manifests/overlay-layers.tsv -- reviewed PARTIAL squashfs overlay layers.
# A finished image normally ships full squashfs layers, each carrying its own
# /var/lib/dpkg/status.  A layer listed HERE is a reviewed PARTIAL overlay: it
# deliberately installs only a subtree (declared as an `opaque` dir in its
# <layer>.overlay-manifest) and therefore has NO dpkg database.  The gate must
# NOT fail such a layer as "no readable var/lib/dpkg/status" -- but it must not
#   * a status-less layer that is NOT listed here still HARD-FAILS;
#   * a listed layer must actually contain its declared tree root, or it fails.
# Columns (TAB): layer (basename), tree_root (repo-relative path the layer must
# contain), recipe, source_revision, note.  recipe (col 3) and source_revision
# (col 4) must be non-empty -- same strictness as manifests/ncz-packages.tsv.
# Adding a row is a reviewed act: the layer must be reproducibly built by the
# named recipe from the named source revision.

column5: partial overlay: opaque /opt/singularity only; 588/589 files are the ncz-singularity-desktop .deb payload plus the ld.so.conf.d/singularity.conf snippet the deb postinst writes
